name: @fhevm/hardhat-plugin-v3-e2e-dev
description: e2e test suite for Hardhat plugin v3 (esm only)

scripts.build: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run compile
scripts.clean: rm -rf artifacts cache cache-forge types out broadcast *.tsbuildinfo
scripts.fmt: npm run prettier:write && npm run forge:fmt
scripts.fmt:check: npm run prettier:check && npm run forge:fmt:check
scripts.lint: npm run compile && npm run forge:lint && eslint && tsc -p ./tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:anvil:simple: hardhat test --network anvil --grep 'encrypted count should be uninitialized after deployment'
